description: This PHP source file defines the implementation of the third step of an import process within the SuiteCRM platform. It includes class definition, dependencies, and logic for rendering the import step 3 UI, handling file parsing, field mapping, and form validation.

classes.name: ImportViewStep3
classes.description: Handles the display and logic of step 3 in the import process, including rendering the UI, managing field mappings, file parsing, and validation.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Renders the import step 3 interface, manages import mappings, processes uploaded files, and sets up the form for user interaction.

methods.name: getMappingClassName
methods.description: Determines the class name for the import mapping based on source, checking for custom and default mappings.

methods.name: getRequestDelimiter
methods.description: Returns the delimiter used for parsing import files, based on user input or default settings.

methods.name: getImportColumns
methods.description: Extracts column mapping information from the request parameters.

methods.name: _getCSS
methods.description: Provides inline CSS styling for the import step 3 page.

methods.name: _getJS
methods.description: Generates JavaScript code used for client-side validation and dynamic interface behavior.
